prayerExcerpt.en-US: Be intimate with her; confide in her; commend to her every want and every project, small as well as great.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sê íntimo dela; confia nela; recomenda-lhe toda necessidade e todo projeto, tanto os pequenos quanto os grandes.

meta.face: A Rhinelander of about twenty-five, visibly a young man and not a boy, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a fair, fresh complexion and a SHORT, ROUND face under a prominent, ROUNDED, BOSSED forehead — a WIDE, low, flat nose bridge and a SMALL, slightly UPTURNED nose, very LARGE, wide-set, clear brown eyes under soft, high-arched brows, round, full cheeks, a small, soft rosebud mouth, a small, round chin; thick, dark-brown CURLY hair round the tonsure; the gaze trusting and loving, lifted to the image. The statue's face: a Romanesque carved face, long, calm and stylised, painted, with a gilt crown.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; van Dyck's 'Vision of the Blessed Hermann Joseph' (Wikipedia's lead image) shows him as a young, dark-haired canon in white. Wikipedia: his devotion at St. Maria im Kapitol, the apple, the white Premonstratensian habit, and the apple still left at his tomb; the church keeps a 'Hermann-Josef' Virgin with the apple of about 1180 (Wikipedia, St. Maria im Kapitol). The card shows him young, with van Dyck and the book's 'early death'; Wikipedia says he died in 1241 at about ninety. The round face with the bossed forehead is our choice.
